column1: # Curated symbol table for the MStar MST9U (AEON) scaler AP.
# Our own annotations (not vendor symbols) — edit freely and re-run regen.sh.
# Addresses are RAM, image = COMBINED (ap_prefix.bin + ap_decompressed.bin) at
# 0x180000 (i.e. the inflated stream sits at 0x183800). Applied after the auto
# namer so these override it. Confidence: [C]=confirmed [I]=inferred [?]=tentative.
# RESET 2026-10-11: emptied after the load-base fix (prior entries were 0x3800
# low). Rebuild from fresh regen.sh dumps / the auto tsv. A few base-fixed
# anchors below, re-derived on the correct base:
# ---- OSD (RESTORED on correct base; the master-table model was right, the
#      earlier retraction was the 0x3800 base bug) ----

column4: [C] screen_id -> per-language (ptr,len) table. master[4] -> no-signal screen
[C] current OSD screen id; ==4 is the no-input/no-signal screen
[C] no-input/no-signal state handler: sets g_osd_mode=4, branches on input flags DAT_ram_00304b88, calls scaler register writes (the blue background fill is among these)
[C] prints "Enable Frame Color", writes scaler colour regs = the no-signal background/frame fill
[C] references "Mute BMP Logo"; draws the mute/logo screen
[C] debug print (no-op unless g_dbg_enable set); takes a string arg
[C] byte write to a scaler register: *(g_scaler_mmio_base + enc(reg)) = val
[C] writes a 24-bit value (e.g. RGB colour) to reg,reg+1,reg+2 via scaler_mmio_write_byte
[?] writes scaler reg 0x101d20 (called by no-input handler)
[C] base pointer for scaler MMIO register writes
[I] per-window context array (stride 0x70); indexed in frame-color fn
